title: Reckoner footer (v2)
description: A quiet two-half footer on linen paper, split by sand hairlines. Left: the wordmark at the top; the parent-company line in the accent colour, a legal note, legal links and a short sitemap at the bottom. Right: a 32px statement, an email field drawn as a single underline with a square sand button, a consent note, and a social link and contact groups at the bottom. On phones it becomes one column. Links underline and take the accent colour on hover.
notes: the parent line and link hovers use the glow colour (crimson in reckoner-v2-theme)
the form is markup only: point action at your own endpoint
